# Adarsh Mishra

> Portfolio of Adarsh Mishra — AI engineer, quantitative-research consultant at WorldQuant BRAIN, and open-source contributor with 43 merged pull requests in other people's projects. Agentic AI, alpha research and mathematical modeling, on one hand-built page.

Adarsh Mishra (`@Adarsh-Me`) builds systems that have to hold up: agents that finish the task, alphas that survive their own backtest, patches that land in codebases much larger than his own. The site is a single dark, centred column — no framework, no template, no analytics, no cookies. Its editable copy is [`content.js`](https://agentic-portfolio-aoao8vruc5c.qoder.website/content.js); its GitHub numbers are [`data.js`](https://agentic-portfolio-aoao8vruc5c.qoder.website/data.js).

**Read this file instead of the HTML body.** Most lists on the page are injected by JavaScript after load, so a crawler or model that does not execute scripts sees a near-empty `<body>`. The sections below are that same content in text; [`llms-full.txt`](https://agentic-portfolio-aoao8vruc5c.qoder.website/llms-full.txt) adds every project bullet, every role and every merged PR.

## Pages

One page — each section is an anchor on it.

## Projects

- [Agent-Audit](https://github.com/Adarsh-Me/Agent-Audit) (2026, Product · LLM evals): Can AI shopping agents actually see, choose and buy from your catalogue? (Live https://agentaudit-web.antideploy.com/)
- [Image-SDK](https://github.com/Adarsh-Me/Image-SDK) (2026, Library · TypeScript): One interface, eight image-generation providers.
- [Sovereign AI](https://github.com/Adarsh-Me/Sovergien) (2026, Research · Model provenance): TensorGuard-Lite: auditing 'open-washed' sovereign models without training them (Research paper https://github.com/Adarsh-Me/Sovergien/blob/main/Sovereign_AI_Reseach_Paper.pdf · Open in Colab https://colab.research.google.com/github/Adarsh-Me/Sovergien/blob/main/TensorGuard_Lite_Colab.ipynb).
- [Lumiere](https://github.com/Adarsh-Me/Lumiere-Shorts-Generator) (2026, Experiment · TypeScript): Short-form video, generated in the browser (Live https://lumierevid.netlify.app/).

## Roles

- **Research Consultant — WorldQuant BRAIN** (2026 — now). Alpha research on the BRAIN platform: hypothesis to expression to backtest to submission.
- **Freelance developer — Cargo ERP — logistics platform** (2026 — now). Built and maintain a cargo ERP that now runs 300+ AWB bookings a day.
- **Open source contributor — Apache · LLVM · Kubernetes · kornia · OWASP** (2026 — now). 43 merged pull requests across 14 other people's projects.
- **Independent builder — Agent-Audit · Image-SDK · Sovereign AI** (2025 — now). Agent-Audit: 640 controlled LLM trials for agentic commerce, with a bounded test-mode checkout.

## Stack

- **Languages:** Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Kotlin, Java, C / C++.
- **AI:** LangChain, LangGraph, PyTorch, Agent evals.
- **Web:** React, Next.js, Node.js.
- **Quant:** WorldQuant BRAIN, Alpha research, Backtesting.
- **Infra:** Git, GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes, Linux.

## Open source

Counted from the GitHub search API on 27 Oct 2026. The page re-reads the same query on every visit, so treat these as a floor.

- [46 merged pull requests — 43 of them in other people's projects, across 14 repositories](https://github.com/search?q=is%3Apr%20is%3Amerged%20author%3AAdarsh-Me&type=pullrequests)
- [checkstyle/checkstyle — 14 merged](https://github.com/checkstyle/checkstyle): a staged migration of the `XpathRegression` suites onto the inline config parser, plus one release-notes archive redirect fix.
- [kornia/kornia — 9 merged](https://github.com/kornia/kornia): scale-independent homography grid warps, capture-safe loss and metric checks, `dataclass_to_dict` namedtuple fields, So3/Se3 test stubs, depth-warp naming docs.
- [apache/maka — 7 merged](https://github.com/apache/maka): linked-worktree read boundaries, a lost launch election no longer read as a Host failure, `fsync` of the artifact directory after a rename, one transient update-check retry.
- [kubernetes/kubernetes — 2 merged](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes): removed a dead `e2e_node` jenkins conformance script and the `WindowsHostNetwork` feature gate.
- [llvm/llvm-project — 2 merged](https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project): flang semantics — a DATA-style initializer on `EXTERNAL`/`INTRINSIC` is now rejected — and a clang Modules lambda-capture regression test.
- One merged PR each in [abhinav-phi/neuroAd_engine](https://github.com/abhinav-phi/neuroAd_engine), [abhinav-phi/optyra](https://github.com/abhinav-phi/optyra), [apache/arrow](https://github.com/apache/arrow), [apache/dolphinscheduler](https://github.com/apache/dolphinscheduler), [apache/hugegraph-doc](https://github.com/apache/hugegraph-doc), [apache/pekko-connectors](https://github.com/apache/pekko-connectors), [apache/superset](https://github.com/apache/superset), [jenkinsci/gitlab-plugin](https://github.com/jenkinsci/gitlab-plugin), [OWASP/CheatSheetSeries](https://github.com/OWASP/CheatSheetSeries).
- [Every merged PR with date, title and link](https://agentic-portfolio-aoao8vruc5c.qoder.website/llms-full.txt)
